release_notes:
RJD PisoWiFi System v3.14.28 - Zero-Delay Instant Network Blocking & UI Cleanup

🎨 UI Clean Up: Removed Proceed to Internet Button
- Completely removed the 'PROCEED TO INTERNET' button from the captive portal session view per user request

⚡ Zero-Delay Instant Internet Blocking (Paused & 0-Time Devices)
- Fixed ensureBlockedNoSession to treat paused sessions (is_paused = 1) as non-active, preventing probe bypass
- Reduced EXPIRED_GUARD_RECHECK_INTERVAL from 60 seconds to 5 seconds for instant background reconciliation
- Synchronously flushes all Linux conntrack socket directions (-s, -d, -r, -q) and applies immediate FORWARD REJECT rules
